Architecture decision records

ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) document the decisions of the scientific artifact architecture described in #6 and in sub-issues PHASE-00 to PHASE-08 (#7 to #15). Each decision records its context, alternatives, solution, rationale, trade-offs, scientific and migration implications, validation requirements and deviations from the reference specification.

Process

  • An ADR is created in the phase listed below, with status Proposed, from the

template.

  • A decision becomes Accepted when its AC criteria have verifiable evidence.

A superseded decision is never deleted: its status becomes Superseded by ADR-XXX.

  • Numbers are permanent and never reused.
  • Each ADR has a Portuguese version (docs/adr/) and an English one

(docs/en/adr/).

Starting evidence

The PHASE-00 assessment is in docs/validation/artifact_architecture_assessment_2026-11-26 (in Portuguese, following the validation reports convention). It contains the inventory, the baseline measurements, the requirement register and the implementation plan that every ADR must take into account.
